title: Quasi-Hopf reconstruction of finite tensor categories with a quasi-fiber functor
difficulty_reason: After the already adopted quasi-bialgebra/twist reconstruction, ordinary Hopf antipode and finite rigidity theorem are supplied, a noncoherent quasi-fiber structure does not identify the transported evaluation/coevaluation with the usual duality of vector spaces. The remaining author construction chooses the isomorphism ξ:F(V)≅F(V*)*, extracts S, α, β, realizes naturality and the two associator-dependent triangle identities (5.27)–(5.28), then explicitly recovers rigid module duals from them and transports the antipode along the twist. This coupled reconstruction and comparison of the quasi-antipode data in both directions is the new H2. Count 5.13.1 and the explicit twist formulas inside the single theorem.
